label: Google Calendar Event
description: An event on a Google Calendar, captured with upstream fidelity. Mirrors the Calendar API event resource closely so a round-trip preserves the fields Google considers authoritative. For cross-app interop with non-Google consumers, the Google Calendar connector can also be configured to write to `core.event` instead, but the default and the fidelity choice is this type.

starts_at.description: Start time. ISO datetime for timed events; ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for all-day events.

ends_at.description: End time. ISO datetime for timed events; ISO date for all-day events.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. "Europe/London") from Calendar `start.timeZone`. Set on timed events; omitted on all-day events. This is the start zone; `end_timezone` carries `end.timeZone` when Calendar reports a different one.

end_timezone.description: IANA timezone from Calendar `end.timeZone`, carried when it differs from `timezone`. Calendar exposes the two separately and offers the choice in its own interface, so collapsing them loses a fact the user entered.

all_day.description: True when the event is an all-day event (Calendar `start.date` instead of `start.dateTime`). The declared answer, not an inference from whether `starts_at` happens to carry a time.

html_link.description: Stable HTTPS link to the event on the Google Calendar web UI.

etag.description: Calendar's change-detection token. Used for conditional updates and as the content-hash key for echo suppression.

source_calendar_id.description: ID of the Google Calendar this event lives on (the user's primary calendar, a shared work calendar, etc.). Set on inbound items so multi-calendar mappings round-trip; outbound writes derive the target calendar from this field or fall back to the connection's configured default.

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time on the user's calendar (Calendar `transparency`).

organizer_email.description: Email address of the event organizer (Calendar `organizer.email`).

creator_email.description: Email address of the event creator (Calendar `creator.email`).

recurrence.description: RRULE / RDATE / EXDATE strings (Calendar `recurrence`). Carried verbatim so the series round-trips, and read by the occurrence expansion. EXRULE is deprecated in RFC 5545 and the expander refuses it outright rather than accepting a line it would silently not apply.

recurring_event_id.description: When set, this event is an instance of a recurring series; value is the Calendar event id of the series parent.

color_id.description: Calendar event color id (numeric string, 1–11; see Calendar's `colors.get`).

original_starts_at.description: For an event that replaces one occurrence of a series, the start time of the occurrence it replaces (Calendar `originalStartTime`). Its series is named by a parent-of edge.
